tools.name: bank_npa_reconciliation

tools.name: banking_specialisation_coverage
tools.description: Indian bank, SFB and UCB coverage with observed, stale, historical and absent evidence. Free research; not a census or rating.

tools.name: corporate_transmission_board
tools.description: Answers ONE question: is US funding stress reaching nonfinancial firms? Use household_credit_board for households. CP, bank credit lines and real-economy confirmation; cannot_see preserves gaps. Seiche context never enters regime or transmission. Display-only; no institution score or tier. full:true

tools.name: crypto_exposure_board
tools.description: Read the compact cited bank/crypto exposure register: disclosed quantum, stablecoin and venue links, exposure channels, Undertow run-risk cross-read and compound flags. Detailed disclosures stay on the public REST detail route. Takes no arguments; display-only, never an institution score or investme

tools.name: crypto_regime_board
tools.description: Read the compact BTC/ETH Crypto Regime board: current change-point state, log-SR statistic, last shift, observation count and the display-only cross-read against disclosed bank exposure. Time-series paths stay on the public REST detail route. Takes no arguments; feeds no institution score and is not

tools.name: evidence_europe
tools.description: Read seven cited European retrospective case files through unrecalibrated Indian lenses. Named case studies, not a cohort: no European recall percentage to quote. Omit slug for summaries, or supply a returned slug for a full quarterly case file.

tools.name: evidence_india
tools.description: Read the 48-institution Indian construction-PIT crisis diagnostic, including misses and false alarms. Uses publication clocks where present and a +60-day filing-lag proxy otherwise; overwritten amendments are unreconstructable. evidence_institution returns a full replay.

tools.name: evidence_institution
tools.description: Read a sourced Indian construction-PIT quarterly replay, lens alert timing and hit/miss/false-alarm verdict. Use evidence_india for exact slugs. Filing-availability proxies do not establish a validated backtest.

tools.name: evidence_markets
tools.description: Historical evidence: India (48-institution construction-PIT diagnostic), US (industry-wide current-amended vintage), Europe (named cases, no cohort claim). Start here, then evidence_india, evidence_us or evidence_europe for details.

tools.name: evidence_us
tools.description: Read US bank current-amended-vintage diagnostics and named replays, including misses. Not a validated point-in-time backtest. Report the quarterly top-decile budgeted watchlist beside recall, uncertainty and lead times; it is not an individual-bank verdict. include_trajectories:true adds histories.

tools.name: failure_radar_board
tools.description: Read fresh-vetted Indian lender rows with failure PDs, disclosure, PCA/SAF, funding and listed-name DD. Scalar market_dd requires tier authority; display-only DD retains clocks and refusal reasons in market_dd_evidence. Discover slugs here, then failure_radar_institution. Research screen, not a cred

tools.name: failure_radar_institution
tools.description: Read one Indian lender dossier: quarterly PDs and drivers, PCA/SAF headroom, funding, forensic and listed-market evidence. Discover slugs with failure_radar_board. Uncovered institutions remain absent, never scored from memory.

tools.name: forward_odds
tools.description: Read counted Markov transitions and empirical 5/20-day reach odds. Odds are withheld until 60 observed days; counts stay visible and absence is never precision. Historical frequencies are not calibrated forecasts. Display-only, never a state driver.

tools.name: household_credit_board
tools.description: Answers ONE question: is stress reaching US household credit? Use corporate_transmission_board for firms. Delinquency, charge-offs, revolving credit and unscored debt-service context; gaps stay in cannot_see. Display-only; no institution score or watchlist tier. full:true adds methods and histories.

tools.name: institution_research_coverage
tools.description: Search Indian dossiers or RBI rows and evidence gaps. Populations overlap; do not infer identity or financial coverage from registry presence. Research only; no scoring.

tools.name: institution_review_packet
tools.description: Build a compact cited human review packet from canonical fresh-vetted Indian radar records. Exact slug or uniquely normalized full name only; no fuzzy matching or new score. Preserves stale/dark gaps and validation hashes. Its content hash detects alteration; it is not attestation or a publication-t

tools.name: latest_article
tools.description: Read today's exact full-text LiquiLens editorial: current institution-risk analysis when the evidence moved, or a labelled historical replay when it did not. Returns the canonical headline, dek, Markdown, evidence clock and passing publication receipt; quote it without regenerating facts.

tools.name: rbi_supervisory_tape
tools.description: Read the latest RBI enforcement and supervisory actions — monetary penalties, licence cancellations and supervisory directions — parsed from rbi.org.in press releases, newest first, each item carrying the RBI's own source URL. Takes no arguments. When no tape snapshot exists on the deployment, says

tools.name: research_network
tools.description: Route to Palimpsest sources, Seiche funding, Undertow exit liquidity and NarcoScope data. Set limit for full metadata. Rights remain attached; no identity, score or eligibility changes.

tools.name: stablecoin_rails_board
tools.description: Read the compact Stablecoin Rails board: every tracked issuer's peg, redemption-run, direct-chain liability validation, coverage-gated reserve and executable-exit evidence, chain concentration and tripwire state plus the aggregate regime. Series and full receipts stay on the public REST detail route

tools.name: universe_search
tools.description: Search the RBI NBFC register by name/CIN substring, classification or regulation layer. Returns official register rows. Supply q or a filter; a filter without q browses that slice. Registration does not establish creditworthiness.

tools.name: verify_published_record
tools.description: Verify a ledger stream by recomputing hash-chain commitments and checking enabled signatures and anchors. Returns the actual verifier verdict, including failures. Verifies record integrity, not economic accuracy.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: crypto_regime_board, rbi_supervisory_tape · Private data: evidence_europe, institution_review_packet, verify_published_record · Public sink: forward_odds · Destructive: crypto_exposure_board, stablecoin_rails_board.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: crypto_regime_board, rbi_supervisory_tape · Private data: evidence_europe, institution_review_packet, verify_published_record · Public sink: forward_odds · Destructive: crypto_exposure_board, stablecoin_rails_board

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "bank_asset_quality_review" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
